notes.title: 🔥 New update available ! 🔥
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We’re very excited to bring you this update with features requested by the community, the main focus of this update is to make exploration more enjoyable, it includes :

🗺️ Addition of a map.

📡 Introduction of a radar item that allows you to locate hidden items on the map. This item is acquired after defeating the third boss.

🚀 Additional teleportation portals to speed up travel between areas and enhance exploration.

🗡️ Increase in the main character's melee attack range.

👹 Addition of an anticipation animation for the third boss's melee attack.

🛠️ Various minor bug fixes for a smoother experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028325/389034dceed9031b0193e3dc11ca516191c9408f.png[/img]
We hope you will be happy with these changes ! Update your game now and let us know what you think in the discussions! We can't wait to read your feedback !
